description: Create a new custom audience. Subtype determines the audience source (CUSTOM, WEBSITE, APP, OFFLINE_CONVERSION, LOOKALIKE, ENGAGEMENT, etc.).

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the audience in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

customer_file_source.description: Source of customer file: USER_PROVIDED_ONLY, PARTNER_PROVIDED_ONLY, BOTH_USER_AND_PARTNER_PROVIDED

retention_days.description: Retention period; allowed range depends on the audience source

rule.description: JSON object defining website, video, or engagement audience rules. This creates an audience; validate-only is not supported.

name: create_custom_audience
